description: Re-measured before the GUI host readiness work (plan_gui_host_readiness.md); values stayed within run-to-run jitter of the 721d74a baseline. Allocated bytes from BenchmarkDotNet MemoryDiagnoser SimpleJob (1 KB = 1024 B, ceiling): maximum of four runs in the repository checkout, excluding single-run outliers that doubled (Capture_32KiB_Text 251 KB, Capture_32KiB_DisplayPlain 319 KB). Measure in the same checkout path: spawn allocations grow with the executable path length, and a worktree under a long temp path added ~1.5 KB. Async paths jitter by roughly 50-400 B between runs. win-x64 run on 2026-10-15.
